author: rhpsystems
quote: The game isn't just riddled with bugs, almost as glaring as those in the Cyberpunk launch, but it's clear the whole story is garbage that mocks people. You have to take care of your girlfriend when she's on her period, you have to be the errand boy. It's like The Sims but full of bugs; I never thought Rockstar would destroy everything they'd built like this. RDR2 is 1000 times better and came out almost 10 years ago. A game where you CAN'T STEAL CARS if a progressive woman has an anxiety attack. Seriously? Absolute garbage.

author: rhpsystems
quote:
I played the whole series of CoD, I have to admit that nothing beats BO2, this game is very well achieved. The gameplay is intensive, the weapons are very good, it does not have strange and stupid things like BO3 (walking on the walls, for example) and they are easily split. This is the good part.

The bad part is that the PC version (which I own) is infested with cheaters, for which neither Activision nor Trayarch seem to worry. They seem to be more focused on generating money than looking after the gameplay and servers. In South America the servers are in Brazil, and cheats infect 3 out of 2 parties. This makes many players finally abandon the games. Do something with this, stop thinking about money.

author: rhpsystems
quote:
A remake of BF1, are no type of control over the classes, where in open spaces all choose to be snipers, where vehicles like airplanes seem toy arcade style. There is no team game, the type of classes per squad is not limited, which makes everything unbalanced.

And of course the story, which does not reflect reality at all. It's a joke, where in order to get along with the feminist community they turned the game into a struggle of men and women alike, something totally outside of historical reality.

A big disappointment, like everything EA has been doing lately. Without a doubt, I will play Black Ops 4 again, trying to forget that I threw 70 USD in a game that is not worth it at all.
